correctness.rationale: For X=Sym^d(P^n_C), n,d>=2, N=nd, the ordered configuration F=(P^n)^d minus diagonals has complement codimension n>=2 and an etale S_d-quotient U. Equivariant Picard descent and the lifted symmetric external tensor product give Pic(U)=Z[L] plus sign Z/2; codimension-2 invariance yields Cl(X)=Pic(U), while sign does not descend as Cartier at a transposition, so Pic(X)=Z[L]. Simple connectivity of F and H²(F,Z)=Z^d plus integral Cartan–Leray give H²(U,Z)=Z[L] plus H²(S_d,Z)=Z/2 represented by c1(sign). The invariant free generator lifts, eliminating possible differentials and showing c1 is an integral isomorphism. Chow and Borel–Moore localization (collision dimension <=N−n and n>=2) identify CH_{N−1}(X)→H_{2N−2}(X,Z) with that same c1 isomorphism. For point multiplicity blocks lambda_i, the stabilizer is product S_{lambda_i} and no element acts as a pseudo-reflection since each swap moves n>=2 normal directions; its character group is (Z/2)^r for r repeated blocks, and the global sign restricts diagonally. The canonical permutation determinant is sign^n, and the minimum nonidentity age is n/2, proving K=−(n+1)L+(n mod2)tau, Cartier iff even n, canonical n=2 and terminal n>=3. These are uniform exact topological and quotient arguments, not finite experiments.
